name: Do As ~Oshishou no Iinari~
original_name: ドゥアズ ～お師匠ノ言いなり～
source:
The protagonist grew up in a ninja village, thinking "There's no such thing as a ninja in this day and age."

One day, he is selected to train Kaede, who is not making much progress in her training. He's usually annoyed by Kaede's fondness for him, but after seeing how much her body has developed recently, he's not entirely unhappy with the situation. He decides to teach her the art of lovemaking, under the guise of combat training.

During escape training, he ties her up with a rope and starts playing with her! During combat training, he focuses on women's weak spots! And then...

[Translated from the [url=https://www.girls-software.com/doas/#character]official website[/url]]
translation:
主角在忍者村长大，认为“这个时代没有忍者”。

有一天，他被选中来训练枫，而枫的训练却没有取得太大进展。他通常会因为枫对自己的喜爱而感到恼火，但在看到她的身体最近发展了这么多之后，他对这种情况也并非完全不满意。他决定以格斗训练为幌子，教她做爱的艺术。

逃生训练时，他用绳子把她绑起来，开始玩弄她！格斗训练时，他重点针对女性的弱点！然后…

[翻译自[url=https://www.girls-software.com/doas/#character]官网[/url]]
